area: Client Connector fleet depth (zcc_fleet, zcc_fleet_import, zcc_fleet_history, /api/zcc/fleet/*, static/report_fleet.html, static/zcc_fleet.js): version x service matrix, profile health, last seen, sites, history and trends, portal CSV import, PDF and Excel exports
title: Fleet depth built and checked against fixtures and the sample tenant: semantics at each boundary, untrusted CSV and history input, counts-only exports, the UI in Chrome

checks.what: Version x service matrix: registered devices per platform and version, each service's active share among known statuses, newest and unsupported marked
A version 10 or more points below the fleet with at least 5 known devices is flagged; 4 known never; the boundary itself flags
No service status: shares are unknown (None), never 0% or 100%; configuration only has no new view at all
Health per app profile and, through the read app profile, per forwarding profile; an unread app profile is never guessed onto a forwarding profile
Last-seen buckets exact to the second (24 h, 7 d, 30 d), registered devices only, per platform
Site grouping by prefix length, delimiter or pick list; no regular expression mode; every field range-checked (11 hostile rules refused)
Counts-only site tables merge sites with fewer than 3 registered devices
History snapshot holds counts and versions only (no user, host, UDID, profile or site)
History file owner-only 0600, atomic replace, one snapshot per read, 60 per tenant, 20 tenants; forget needs confirm
A tampered history file is read as untrusted: wrong types, markup, impossible values and oversize or deeply nested files dropped
Trend deltas and compare (versions new and gone); out-of-range compare is a 400
Portal CSV import: base64 / gzip-base64 / text, UTF-16 BOM and cp1252, header found after a preamble, export time from the portal's file names, pairs more than 12 hours apart flagged
Import caps: 48 MB per file before and after decoding, bounded gzip inflation (bomb refused), 200,000 rows, 300 columns, 200 characters a cell, NUL bytes and damaged uploads refused with a reason
Import route builds no tenant client and needs no sign-in; formula-looking host names neutralised in CSV and Excel; markup stays text
PDF report counts only (no user, host or UDID), A4 or Letter, every section; Excel gains Version health, Profile health, Forwarding health, Last seen, Sites, History
Start route: a bad site rule is a 400 before sign-in; the Scope rule is unchanged (ZCC must be ticked)
UI in Chrome on the sample tenant: every new section renders, site form fields follow the mode, chart named in words with a table, compare, forget asks first
Hostile imported host name stays text (no element, no script)
No sideways scroll at 320px with every new section (read and import); every new control takes keyboard focus; help entry and ? mark for each new control

findings.title: A service-status file with both "ZIA Enabled" and "ZIA Health" was read by the Enabled column when it came first, so an enabled but inactive service counted as active
findings.fix: zcc_fleet.service_columns prefers health, status, state, then service; Enabled is kept apart and an Enabled=false service is not applicable

findings.title: The offline SDK client had no get_request_executor, so the sample tenant's fleet could never read a service status (always 'partly read')
findings.fix: OfflineSdkClient.get_request_executor (as the SDK's OneAPI client); the sample tenant serves a service-status CSV

findings.title: A device record without a last-seen time counted as never seen although the service-status file had its last-seen time
findings.fix: normalize_devices falls back to the service row's last-seen column for the same device

findings.title: The new-marks browser tests were bound to the 2026-10-28 marks on the Path analyzer and failed as soon as a newer release rotated them out
findings.fix: tests/test_new_marks.py injects probe features for the two marked releases and reads the expected dates from CHANGELOG.md
